name: Badge
purpose: Communicates status, category labels, or counts in a compact, high-contrast capsule.
neverUseFor: Decoration or visual interest with no semantic meaning
Long text — badges truncate at 24 characters
Navigation items — use NavItem or Tab instead
rationale: Badge uses its own local density model (20/24px) instead of the ADR-004 control ladder because it is a non-interactive label, not a control. Its off-scale 6px side padding is split into 4px + 2px scale tokens across nested boxes so no value is hardcoded, and every tone pairs a tinted fill with a text-* token checked for AA contrast in both themes.

mayExtendLocally: Choose the tone, icon and label text per usage
Add role='status' when the badge content updates dynamically
mustEscalateToDS: Adding new tones or colors outside the semantic set
Changing badge heights, padding tokens or the 24-character truncation
Making Badge clickable or using it as navigation

anatomy.description: Wraps the icon and label: 4px between them, plus 2px of side padding — together with the root's own padding that gives 6px (xs) / 10px (s) from scale tokens only.

props.name: size
props.description: Horizontal density preset. Badge is a documented exception to the global scale.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon, passed by reference (e.g. IconClock). Rendered via the Icon component at a fixed 12px. Fully opt-in — nothing renders unless supplied. For a status variant, prefer BADGE_ICON_BY_VARIANT[variant] (exported alongside Badge) over picking an icon ad hoc — it matches Toast's own icon shape per variant (Outline build vs Toast's Filled build).

height.note: Badge uses a local density model; this does not redefine the global scale.

a11y.role: status (add role='status' when content is dynamic)
wcag: 1.4.1 Use of Color (don't rely on color alone)

motion: CSS transitions/animations: neutralised by the global prefers-reduced-motion rule

properties.name: icon
properties.description: Show/hide part: the icon sits inside badge-content with its own 4px gap, so the badge's paddings never change.

properties.name: iconSwap
properties.description: Which icon. Default InfoCircle; preferred values are BADGE_ICON_BY_VARIANT's (InfoCircle, CircleCheck, AlertTriangle, AlertHexagon). Like code, the icon isn't tied to the variant — the consumer picks it.
